lineage.strategy: Close the prior provenance limitation with SEC-filed Q2 FY2027 primary evidence and add cash-flow/capital-intensity context.

observations.fact: Planet's filed Q2 FY2027 revenue was $116.052 million versus $73.386 million a year earlier; six-month revenue was $210.202 million versus $139.651 million.

The filed earnings exhibit reports $68.4 million of year-to-date operating cash flow, $21.3 million of year-to-date free cash flow, and $865.4 million of cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments at quarter end.

Planet disclosed capital expenditures equal to 25% of Q2 revenue versus 29% a year earlier and 22% for both six-month periods; management expects capital expenditures to increase as it expands its satellite fleet.

risks.risk: Planet raised about $120 million through its ATM equity program during the quarter, so liquidity growth includes external equity financing and carries dilution risk; satellite fleet expansion remains capital intensive.

unknowns.unknown: The filings do not establish long-run margins or return on capital for the next-generation Pelican and customer-owned satellite programs.

recommendation: Replace the prior independent-only quarterly values with SEC-filed primary values; include positive cash generation, ATM dilution and continuing satellite capital intensity in underwriting.
